_extraction_flags.notes: Valid VLC-ISAC paper (ReflexGest). Integrates HGR (Sensing) and VLC (Comm) using a desk lamp with multi-carrier modulation. Note: Visual analysis file describes a completely different Distributed Fiber Sensing system (mismatch). Extraction based purely on text.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Paper Text describes 'ReflexGest' (VLC lamp HGR). Visual Analysis file describes 'Optical Fiber Sensing' (OTDR/BOTDA). Mismatch identified. Using Text.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: VLC-ready desk lamp with ring LED array and PD. Sensing: Reflected Light Intensity for Hand Gesture Recognition (HGR). Comm: VLC (Visible Light Communication). Technique: Multi-carrier modulation (40-70 kHz) for spatial diversity + Adversarial Learning for robustness.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 50 kbps (experimental), 220 kbps (prototype throughput). Sensing: HGR Classification Accuracy >90% (not range/res).
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Low-cost ISAC for IoT/Smart Home using commodity LEDs. Overcomes spatial information loss in varying reflections.

bibliographic.title: ReflexGest: Recognizing Hand Gestures Under VLC-Capable Lamps
bibliographic.authors: Ziwei Liu, Jifei Zhu, Jiaqi Yang, Yimao Sun, Yanbing Yang, Jun Luo

application.scenario_description: Smart desk lamp performing simultaneous lighting, VLC, and touch-free hand gesture recognition.

key_contribution.key_contribution: ReflexGest: A reflected VL-HGR system piggybacking on VLC-capable lamps using multi-carrier spatial modulation and adversarial domain adaptation.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of spatial information in single-PD reflected sensing and interference from varying table surfaces.

transmitter.notes: Commercial LED ring array. Visible light (wavelength estimated ~600nm range). 500 kHz sampling rate.

receiver.notes: Hamamatsu S5971 PD. Direct detection of reflected intensity.

integration.notes: Same LEDs for Comm and Sensing. Full-duplex VLC (uplink/downlink).

waveform.notes: Multi-carrier modulation (40, 50, 60, 70 kHz) carries both comm (dimming/data) and sensing (spatial reflection signatures).

channel_wireless.notes: Table lamp height max 40 cm. Visible light band.
